status: Bounded placement request composition with one root replacement; no runtime adoption
initial_state: Active first root after fence at time zero, renewal and activation at time one; initial expiry two; RootControl Strong checked from the seed
assumptions: RootControl abstract elapsed-time contract, fresh ordered epochs and one outstanding root request per incarnation
Exact conditional register shared by root and placement mutations, including otherwise identical payloads
Never-reused placement invocation IDs; earlier timed-out operations may remain pending
All historical placement observations belonging to the querying root active phase remain possible; foreign/inactive observations are rejected without changing local state
properties: Imported root strengthening, root exclusion and child containment/exclusion
Validated local open views agree with current placement while their root remains valid
Issued generation permission remains within its root interval
Live generation permission cannot overlap between roots or generations

coverage.event: Replacement-generation issuance after an applied, timed-out predecessor freeze and earlier old-generation issuance
coverage.guided_action_constraint: RecoveryActions; removes schedules from WireSpec without adding transitions. The positive instance remains unrestricted.

limitations: One replacement from a reachable active-root seed; no arbitrary repeated takeover or competing acquisition candidates
Root request transitions are imported as modeled, not a complete refinement of provider reads, invocation uncertainty or election
No physical clock conversion, platform timing guarantee or process snapshot/restore semantics
No journal selection, transaction values/receipts, admission, reclamation or liveness
No unbounded wire-composition theorem, Rust controller or implementation refinement
The current HTTP serving engine still performs conditional read barriers

qualification.status: Local standard checker passed; full Woodpecker qualification and publication pending
